messages:
Maria: Quick sync — final gate snapshot for Predictor v1. Need owners to confirm SLA/docs/support/monitoring/pricing experiment readiness by Thu EOD. Planned GA: Mon 2026-04-06. Open items: p99 latency SLO, monthly availability SLO, billing overage guardrails, KB/runbook, PagerDuty tuning. Owners: Josh (SLA/infra), Kate (docs), Ryan (monitoring/oncall), Sam (support), Li (pricing/FinOps).

Josh: Infra status — we propose availability SLO 99.95% monthly and p99 latency target 700ms for hosted tier. Test cluster currently at 99.92% due to driver bug. PR #482 fixes it, rolling to canary. ETA Wed.

Kate: Docs update — Quickstart + migration guide live in draft: https://redwood.docs/predictor-v1/quickstart. Missing final product copy for caching/model-pin callouts. Will finish Thursday AM.

Sam: Support plan — adding extra triage hours first week of GA (9-5 PT). Onboarding playbook ready. Outstanding: billing dispute templates and escalation steps (need one runbook).

Ryan: Monitoring — alerts wired for staging and prod. PD rotation created: predictor-oncall. Current alert thresholds: error rate >0.5% over 5m, p99 >1s for 3m. Suggest we reduce noisy PD pages by making p99 PD threshold 750ms and keep 1s as Slack-only alert.

Li: Pricing/FinOps — recommend keep beta list price for GA but enable a 2% "burst credit" buffer per org for first 30 days to reduce early churn. Also propose a committed-capacity pilot (sales-owned). Need legal OK on promo language.

Maria: Summary of blockers: Josh PR #482 merge; Kate product copy review; Ryan adjust PD thresholds; Sam own billing runbook; Li legal signoff. If owners can ack and list any hidden blockers, we can lock gate.

Josh: PR #482 merged at 6612345692. Canary rollout to 10% in staging now. Observability: p99 = 680ms on canary.

Kate: Product reviewed and updated examples. Added section: "How to pin a model version" and explicit note on sticky prefix cache. Docs link updated.

Sam: KB created: https://support.redwood/predictor-v1/kb. Added triage checklist + email templates for billing disputes. I'll draft the runbook and drop it in the release ticket.

Ryan: Updated alerts: PD threshold now p99 > 750ms for 3m; Slack alert if p99 > 1s. Added low-priority healthcheck for prefix cache hit-rate. Will attach runbook step for paging noise mitigation.

Li: Legal OK pending for promo copy, looped in @legal. Finance comfortable with 2% buffer for 30 days. Committed-capacity pilot materials in sales repo.

Maria: Owners please confirm final: Josh (SLA) ✅ Kate (Docs) ✅ Ryan (Monitoring) ✅ Sam (Support) ✅ Li (Pricing) ✅ — if all green, I'll create the release ticket and send the GA announcement draft to comms/legal. Shipping target Mon 2026-04-06 unless regressions pop. Thanks everyone :tada:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout to prod initiated by Josh at 6612345700 — status: in-progress.

oncall-bot: Reminder — predictor-oncall rotation active for GA window.

Ryan: :thumbsup:
